nawwar.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: transparent character turnaround and expression sheet for an original 2D mobile educational adventure game, ages 6–12.
Style/medium: Hand-painted 2D gouache with layered cut-paper shapes, matte surfaces, restrained warm INTERNAL shading, bold readable silhouettes, gentle brush texture, expressive cocoa-brown eyes. Playful and adventurous with practical oversized accessories, not excessively babyish.
Composition/framing: Clean organized LANDSCAPE sheet: four fully visible full-body views across the upper portion (front, front three-quarter, side, back), and three separated enlarged face portraits below (joy, curiosity, mild confusion). All seven depictions show the SAME character with identical anatomy, colors, proportions and accessory placement. Comfortable transparent spacing between every depiction. Preserve crown/ear/limb counts in every applicable view. Each anatomical count describes total anatomy; allow natural occlusion in side and back views.
Scene/backdrop: GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background with alpha, empty space fully transparent.
Constraints: No ground plane, pedestal, shadow plate or cast shadow. Internal gouache shading within characters is allowed. No text, labels, logos or watermark. No humans, sacred symbols, supernatural imagery, weapons or extra characters. Every figure fully within frame.
Subject: A small original nonhuman pear-shaped apricot creature, broader at the base, with TWO short broad feet and TWO short flexible arms ending in simple rounded hands; no visible neck. Exactly THREE leaf sprouts on the crown: central leaf tallest, outer leaves leaning outward. Cocoa-brown oval eyes, small expressive mouth, a few darker apricot dots near the lower body. ONE turquoise side satchel with diagonal strap and circular-flap closure; keep its body-side placement consistent across the turnaround. Curious, confident posture, softly rounded proportions. Body #F2AD64; satchel #3F938E; crown leaves muted green; eyes #3B3030. No ears, horns, tail or human clothing.
